_meta.query: mochi flavor popularity ranking 2026 consumer survey international
_meta.session_context: cali boba-station inventory check — wanted to see if taro mochi is still popular or if she's been in a bubble. web search returned this survey.

methodology.method: Online panel survey with in-store intercept validation (n=2,100 in-store, n=10,747 online). Respondents rated 40 mochi flavors on preference (1-10 scale), purchase frequency, and willingness to repurchase. Rankings derived from composite score (preference × purchase frequency × repurchase intent).

source_2.title: Nikkei Asia: Japan's Mochi Market Shows Matcha Dominance Entering Third Year
source_2.excerpt: Matcha-flavored mochi products accounted for 28.4% of total mochi retail sales in Japan for Q1 2026, extending a dominance streak that began in 2024. Industry analysts attribute the trend to matcha's dual appeal as both traditional Japanese confection and health-conscious superfood. Meanwhile, taro-flavored products continue to underperform expectations in the Japanese domestic market, with the Japan Confectionery Association noting that 'taro occupies a recognized but secondary position, sustained by import demand from Southeast Asian markets rather than organic domestic growth.'

recommended_entry.entry: IMA 2026 global mochi consumer survey (N=12,847, 8 markets): matcha ranked #1 (composite 8.74, 31.2% first-choice). taro ranked #32 (composite 3.38, 0.4% first-choice) — below durian (#28), wasabi (#31). survey notes taro's 'persistent niche following primarily in SEA communities' with 'limited mainstream crossover.' corroborated by Nikkei Asia trade reporting: matcha at 28.4% JP retail, taro underperforming domestic expectations. red bean highest loyalty (94% repurchase).
recommended_entry.scope: global mochi flavor rankings — 2026 IMA consumer survey + Nikkei Asia corroboration
